answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The garden here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Bonded scaffolder craft token is the proof, because a token scaffolders carry after pole checks. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. A farm faces an examination charge of £49, charged again each time a name fails for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The horizon is checked, not assumed. Every yarrow is counted once.
